kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace update-workspace-resource --workspace-id 123 --is-default true --product-type MaxCompute --group-name group-kjds000000sd --resource-type MaxCompute --labels Value=True Key=system.000000 --resource-ids Resource-dks000000jkf --spec clusterType=share --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateWorkspaceResource

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to set the resource as the default resource for the workspace. Currently, only `true` is a valid value
parameters.help_zh: 是否为默认资源，目前该参数只支持传入true，暂不支持false
parameters.name: is_default

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use `ResourceType` instead
parameters.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，将会下线，请使用ResourceType字段
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values are:

MaxCompute: MaxCompute resources.

ECS: General-purpose computing resources.

Lingjun: Lingjun intelligent computing resources.

ACS: ACS computing resources.

Flink: Flink resources.

SelfManagedAckPro: Resources for self-managed ACK Pro clusters.

SelfManagedAckLingjun: Resources for self-managed ACK Lingjun clusters.

SelfManagedASI: Resources for self-managed clusters on third-party clouds
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型列表。取值如下：

MaxCompute：大数据计算服务资源
ECS：通用计算资源
Lingjun：灵骏智算资源
ACS：ACS计算资源
FLINK：Flink资源
SelfManagedAckPro：AckPro统一管控集群资源
SelfManagedAckLingjun：AckLinjun统一管控集群资源 
SelfManagedASI：ASI统一管控集群资源（三方云）
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: An array of tags. The update affects only resources that have all of the specified tags
parameters.help_zh: 资源标签集合。如果有多个标签，只有同时具备这些标签的资源才会被返回
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en:
An array of resource IDs.

You cannot leave both `GroupName` and `ResourceIds` empty. If you specify both parameters, the group name must be the same for all specified resource IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID集合。

GroupName与ResourceIds不能都为空，但可以都不为空；如果都不为空，集合内每个资源ID的GroupName必须一致
parameters.name: resource_ids
